public class Main {
    static final int N = 250005;
    static int[][] f = new int[N][18];
    static int[] c = new int[18];
    static int[] ans = new int[18];
    static int[] lg = new int[1];
    static int m, n, k, rhl;
    static int[] fac = new int[N];
    static int[] ifac = new int[N];
    static int[] inv = new int[N];
    static int[] cnt = new int[N];
    static int[] v = new int[N];

    static void add(int[] a, int[] b, int fg) {
        for (int i = 0; i < lg[0]; ++i) {
            a[i] += fg != 0 ? b[i] : (rhl - b[i]);
            if (a[i] >= rhl) a[i] -= rhl;
        }
    }

    static void mul(int[] a, int[] b) {
        for (int i = 0; i < c.length; i++) c[i] = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < lg[0]; ++i) {
            if (a[i] == 0) continue;
            for (int j = 0; i + j < lg[0]; ++j) {
                c[i + j] = (int)((1L * a[i] * b[j] + c[i + j]) % rhl);
            }
        }
        System.arraycopy(c, 0, a, 0, c.length);
    }

    static void fpm(int[] a, int b) {
        for (int i = 0; i < ans.length; i++) ans[i] = 0;
        ans[0] = 1;
        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1) != 0) {
                mul(ans, a);
            }
            b >>= 1;
            if (b > 0) {
                mul(a, a);
            }
        }
        System.arraycopy(ans, 0, a, 0, ans.length);
    }

    static int qpow(int a, int b) {
        int ans = 1;
        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1) != 0) {
                ans = (int)((1L * ans * a) % rhl);
            }
            b >>= 1;
            if (b > 0) {
                a = (int)((1L * a * a) % rhl);
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        rhl = sc.nextInt();

        if ((n & 1) == 1) {
            System.out.println(qpow(k, n));
            return;
        }

        fac[0] = 1;
        ifac[0] = 1;
        f[0][0] = 1;

        int tempLg = 0;
        for (int m = 1; m <= n; m <<= 1) {
            tempLg++;
        }
        lg[0] = tempLg;

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            inv[i] = (i == 1) ? 1 : (int)((long)(rhl - rhl / i) * inv[rhl % i] % rhl);
            fac[i] = (int)((long)fac[i - 1] * i % rhl);
            ifac[i] = (int)((long)ifac[i - 1] * inv[i] % rhl);
            cnt[i] = cnt[i >> 1] + (i & 1);
            f[i][cnt[i]] = ifac[i];
        }

        v[n] = 1;
        for (int i = n; i > 0; --i) {
            if (v[i] == 0) continue;
            for (int j = i; j > 0; j &= i) {
                v[j] = 1;
            }
        }

        int mVal = 1;
        while (mVal < n) mVal <<= 1;

        for (int i = 1; i < mVal; i <<= 1) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; ++j) {

                    add(f[j], f[j ^ i], 1);
                }

            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < mVal; i <<= 1) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; ++j) {
                if ((j & i) != 0) {
                    add(f[j], f[j ^ i], 0);
                }
            }
        }

        long result = ((qpow(k, n) - (long)f[n][cnt[n]] * fac[n] % rhl) + rhl) % rhl;
        System.out.println(result);
    }
}
